sn39.1-15:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto vajjīsu viharati ukkavelāyaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
sn39.1-15:1.2: atha kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn39.1-15:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn39.1-15:2.3: yo kho āvuso rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo,
sn39.1-15:2.5: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn39.1-15:2.6: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn39.1-15:3.1: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn39.1-15:3.2: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, seyyathidaṃ:
sn39.1-15:3.4: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn39.1-15:3.5: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
